records.context: **Duplicates.** A figure is identified by its paper (the DOI when there is one) and its image hash. The same image seen again -- the same bytes, or the same pixels in another file format, under another name or another paper, such as a preprint and its published version -- is measured once and recorded in the ``duplicates`` table against the copy that was measured.
